title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
summary: NVIDIA has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12,930,300,000. NVIDIA says it will scale Hugging Face’s platform and expand access to AI for developers and institutions. Hugging Face will remain an open platform for the entire AI ecosystem, and NVIDIA compute will not be required to build on or deploy through Hugging Face.
subject: NVIDIA / Hugging Face
